name: Vulkan LFIT
description: Vulkan LFIT — HD image generation on iGPU. Free, private by default. Three presets: standard, background, hero. Network features require explicit opt-in.

binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the lfit binary. Defaults to bundled bin/lfit. Not PATH-resolved, to prevent hijacking.

allowRemote.description: Allow network operations: Pollinations.ai drafts and remote SD servers. Default: false. Prompts leave your machine when enabled.

allowTelegram.description: Allow auto-pushing generated images to Telegram when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are set. Default: false. Images leave your machine when enabled.
